objects.description: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) has collected information automatically using the adversary's [USBferry](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0452) attack.(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020)
objects.description_fa: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) اطلاعات را به طور خودکار با استفاده از حمله [USBferry](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0452) دشمن جمع‌آوری کرده است.(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020)
